# Attach Players

Source: [6165](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6165); edited 2025-06-14. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Attach Players](../../api/actions/attach-players.md).

<a id="wiki-6165-n1"></a>

- An attached child cannot move freely until detached or teleported away; multiple children can share one parent, not vice versa.

<a id="wiki-6165-n2"></a>

- Offset is relative to parent; example (1,2,0) lies above and left of the parent's head.
